This signature mismatch creates confusion: students reading the task expect to implement addGuestStudents(int) but the template forces a different method shape and parameter name, breaking the clear mapping between requirement and starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template method signature match the UML/problem and the solution by changing the template declaration to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... } (or if validation is required, implement validation internally or provide an overloaded method but keep the primary API addGuestStudents(int) to match the exercise description).
